theme: Light mode primary (Dark mode supported via standard Tailwind 'dark:' classes but optimized for bright retail environments)

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure tight letter spacing for headings. DO NOT use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings. Maintain a strict size hierarchy. Do not exceed text-5xl anywhere in the app.

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Use the custom palette for UI elements. The sidebar should use the dark primary background (#1E1B4B) to ground the app, while the main content area remains light (#F8FAFC) for data legibility. Never use pure #000000 or #808080.

components.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI for complex interactives (Select, Dialog, Tabs). For basic layouts and POS grids, use raw HTML/Tailwind to maintain the dense, custom look. Override Shadcn's default rounded-xl to rounded-md for a sharper, more professional retail feel.

layouts.kpi_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6
layouts.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the sidebar is persistent on desktop. For the POS view, use a split layout: left side for product grid/scanning (2/3 width), right side for the active cart and payment actions (1/3 width). Maximize vertical space for the POS.

motion.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-[1px]) and subtle shadow increase for interactive cards.
motion.instructions_to_main_agent: Avoid 'transition: all' on elements with transforms. Be purposeful. Use Framer Motion for modal entrances or toast notifications if needed.

accessibility.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure high contrast for all text. The POS needs to be fast and readable from a distance. Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements. Support keyboard navigation for the POS (e.g., auto-focusing the barcode scanner input).

image_urls.description: Person holding a smartphone next to a tablet computer (can be used for POS onboarding/hero or dashboard empty states)
Warehouse shelves with boxes (can be used for inventory dashboard banners or empty states)

media.instructions_to_main_agent: Use these images appropriately if an empty state or onboarding screen requires visual flair. Do not use placeholder text for missing images.

icons.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Lucide-React for all icons. Keep stroke width consistent (usually 2). Use informative icons for POS actions (barcode, shopping-cart, credit-card, user-plus).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: 1. Prioritize function over form for this specific app—it's a high-density operational tool. 2. Do not use centered text alignments for tables or forms. 3. Build the specific phase 1 features (Pricing block math, unified inventory grid, POS flow) exactly as requested. 4. Use `data-testid` for all interactive elements. 5. Keep the POS view mobile-friendly and touch-optimized. 6. Avoid 'AI slop' by strictly adhering to the defined color palette and typography scale.
